title: HTTP: add expert warning for malformed response status code tokens
description:
HTTP response status code tokens are not currently validated for\
correct format and malformed tokens are not surfaced through Expert Info.

In basic_response_dissector(), tokens shorter than 3 characters are\
silently ignored, and non-digit or longer tokens may be partially\
parsed without warning.

Add an Expert Info warning for malformed status code tokens:

* Token length not equal to 3
* Non-digit characters present

This improves visibility and filterability of malformed HTTP responses.

This should be

```c
		expert_add_info_format(pinfo, ti, &ei_http_response_code_invalid,
			"Invalid HTTP response status code token: \"s\" (expected exactly 3 digits)",
			format_text(pinfo->pool, status_code_token, tokenlen));
```

to handle the error case where the token is not valid UTF-8 or otherwise not printable.

See #21221
Thanks, updated to use `format_text()` for safe handling of non-UTF-8 input in a follow-up MR.
